title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build and ship perception models for warehouse automation robots. You will own models from training through to on-robot deployment, working alongside robotics engineers rather than handing off to them.
responsibilities: Own model training pipelines end to end, from data collection to evaluation
Deploy and monitor models running on constrained on-robot hardware
Partner with robotics engineers on the perception-to-control interface
Improve the evaluation harness so regressions are caught before customer pilots

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Fleet Services
description: Own the services that coordinate a fleet of robots across customer warehouses — scheduling, telemetry ingestion, and the APIs customers integrate against.
responsibilities: Design and run high-throughput telemetry ingestion from thousands of robots
Own the public fleet API and its versioning story
Lead the on-call practice for fleet services
Mentor two mid-level engineers on the team

title: Platform Engineer, Clinical Data
description: Build the internal platform that clinical product teams deploy on. Regulated environment — every change is audited, and that constraint shapes the work.
responsibilities: Own Terraform modules used by 30+ product teams
Build the audit and compliance tooling that gates production deploys
Reduce CI time for the main monorepo
Run the internal developer support rotation

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Own the pipelines that turn raw clinical feeds into the datasets analytics and ML teams depend on. Correctness matters more than speed here.
responsibilities: Design and operate Kafka-based ingestion for HL7 and FHIR feeds
Own data quality contracts between ingestion and downstream consumers
Partner with the compliance team on data retention and de-identification
Mentor engineers joining from non-healthcare backgrounds

title: Backend Engineer, Payment Rails
description: Own a payment rail end to end — the integration, the reconciliation, and the on-call. Small squad, very high autonomy, minimal direction.
responsibilities: Integrate and operate a national payment scheme end to end
Build reconciliation tooling that finance uses daily
Carry the pager for your own rail
Write the runbooks nobody else will write for you

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Retrieval
description: Own the retrieval layer behind our developer assistant — embeddings, vector indexes, ranking, and the evaluations that keep them honest. Frontier pace, in-office four days a week.
responsibilities: Own the embedding and re-ranking stack end to end
Design offline and online evaluations for retrieval quality
Scale vector search to billions of documents without losing recall
Work directly with founders on product direction

title: Full-Stack Engineer, Shipment Visibility
description: Build the customer-facing shipment tracking experience and the services behind it. Steady pace, real 40-hour weeks, systems that have been running for a decade.
responsibilities: Build and maintain the shipment visibility UI in React
Own the backing services in Java and Python
Pair daily with a rotating partner on non-trivial work
Improve the existing system rather than rewrite it

title: Engineering Manager, Playback
description: Lead the team that owns video playback across every client. A first management role is welcome if you have been a tech lead — the team is stable and senior.
responsibilities: Manage and grow a team of seven engineers across web and mobile
Own playback reliability and startup-time targets
Represent playback at the quarterly architecture review board
Run hiring for the team
